audience: small businesses that track companies, deals and tasks in Cogmento CRM

useCases.title: Review the deal pipeline
useCases.text: The AI totals your deals by pipeline stage, with how many sit at each stage and what they are worth, and lists deals with amounts and close dates.

useCases.title: Keep follow-up tasks on track
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks by due date to find overdue ones, creates follow-up tasks and marks finished tasks complete.

useCases.title: Log a new company and deal
useCases.text: The AI checks that the company is not in Cogmento yet, creates it, and opens a new deal.

useCases.title: Update a deal
useCases.text: The AI finds the deal in your deal list and changes one field at a time, such as its status or a custom field, using the field names from your templates.

useCases.title: Check the account setup
useCases.text: The AI identifies the connected user and reads the account's settings, its number of users, and the fields of each record type, including custom fields.
